description: This short walk visits the Linn Jaw Waterfall in the Pentland Hills area of the Central Scotland Forest. The falls are located just south of Livingston in a lovely peaceful spot. There is a footpath heading east from a country lane to the falls with views of the pretty Bents Burn and Camilty Water. It's a delightful area with further views of the surrounding countryside and hills to enjoy on the walk. You can continue your walking by heading south east to visit the waterside trails at Harperrig Reservoir .
